_README: Template for adding releases to data/discography.json.
Everything lives in that one file — Korean, Japanese and solo together.
Copy a block below into its "albums" array. Order doesn't matter;
the page sorts by "released" and groups by year on its own.
Set "category" so the planned Korean / Japanese / Solo filter picks it up:
Validate before committing:  python3 -m json.tool data/discography.json

_FIELDS.id: REQUIRED. kebab-case, unique across the whole file. Used in the #deep-link.
_FIELDS.title: REQUIRED. As it should display.
_FIELDS.artist: OPTIONAL. The other act on a collaboration, or the member for a solo release.
_FIELDS.seq: Free text under the type badge. '1st Japanese Album', 'Single', '2nd Mini Album'.
_FIELDS.type: REQUIRED. EP | Full Album | Single | Reissue | Compilation
_FIELDS.released: REQUIRED. YYYY-MM-DD. YYYY-MM or YYYY also work and display as 'Jul 2018' / '2018'.
_FIELDS.cover: Square art path, e.g. assets/img/covers/bdz.jpg. "" gives a coloured placeholder.
_FIELDS.note: OPTIONAL. One line under the title in the panel.
_FIELDS.links: Streaming URLs. "" renders the button greyed out, so gaps stay visible.
_FIELDS.tracks[].title: REQUIRED.
_FIELDS.tracks[].titleKo: OPTIONAL. Original-script title — use for the Japanese title.
_FIELDS.tracks[].artist: OPTIONAL. Solo / sub-unit / featured credit. Searchable.
_FIELDS.tracks[].titleTrack: OPTIONAL. true adds the TITLE flag.
_FIELDS.videos[].kind: REQUIRED. mv | lyric | performance | dance | live | audio | other
_FIELDS.videos[].url: REQUIRED. Full YouTube URL, youtu.be, /shorts/, or the bare 11-char id.
_FIELDS.videos[].url_note: Non-YouTube links work too — they become link-out cards.
_FIELDS.videos[].official: true = green Official, false = amber Fan. Omitted counts as official.
_FIELDS.videos[].label: OPTIONAL. Overrides the caption, e.g. 'Dance Practice Video'.
